name: bakudan-website
description: Bakudan Ramen — website + Links Hub + Blog CMS

scripts.build: echo No build step required — static site with Node API

notes.sqlite: Uses Node.js built-in node:sqlite (Node >= 22.5). No native compilation required.
notes.test: npm test runs the Python campaign/security test suite (tests/campaign/run_all.py). Requires Python >= 3.10 and `pip install paramiko`. There is no Node-based test suite; server/ (the Node backend npm test used to point at) was intentionally removed (commit ef613a6) as it was never reachable in production.
